summary: Cleco Partners L.P. entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement on April 24, 2026, to sell all equity interests of Cleco Group, LLC to affiliates of Stonepeak and Bernhard Capital Partners. The filing does not disclose price/share, premium, or implied value, as Cleco is privately held and will remain so. The transaction is subject to customary conditions including LPSC and HSR approvals. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The deal lacks publicly disclosed terms; watch for regulatory filings and potential competing bids given the private nature.
